title: Tool Call Eval v1
description: Flattened evaluation row for a single tool call. One row per tool invocation. Derived from the workflow event stream. Designed for tool-level behavioral analysis — joinable with mission_outcome rows via session_id.

step_index.description: Agent step index when this call was made.

agent_profile.description: Agent profile name active during this call.

tool_name.description: Tool name (e.g. read_file, write_file, search_replace, grep, bash, task).

tool_category.description: Broad tool category for grouping in analysis.

tool_input_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical tool input JSON.

tool_output_sha256.description: SHA256 of the complete tool output text.

tool_output_artifact_path.description: Relative path to artifact file, if output was artifacted.

determinism_class.description: Determinism classification for this tool call.

is_deterministic.description: Derived: true if determinism_class indicates deterministic output.

is_mutating.description: Derived: true if mutation_class indicates file or git mutation.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency for this tool call.

input_bytes.description: Byte size of the tool input.

output_bytes.description: Byte size of the tool output.

inline_output_bytes.description: Bytes returned inline to the model.

truncated.description: Whether output was truncated for prompt visibility.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings emitted during this call.

path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the file path read.

files_read.description: Files read by this tool call (for read_file, git_show, git_diff).

files_read_count.description: Derived: number of files read by this call.

path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the file path changed.

was_protected.description: True if the file was dirty at mission start.

expected_hash_matched.description: True if expected_before_sha256 matched current file bytes.

files_changed.description: Files created or modified by this tool call.

files_changed_count.description: Derived: number of files changed by this call.

refusal_reason.description: Machine-readable refusal reason code, if refused.

refused_path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the path that was refused.

search_query_sha256.description: SHA256 of the normalized search query, if this is a grep call.

search_result_sha256.description: SHA256 of the search result set, if a search was performed.

search_total_matches.description: Total matches returned by the search.

test_command_hash.description: SHA256 of the test command, if this call ran tests.

test_exit_code.description: Process exit code, if this call ran tests.

test_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the test run.

is_retry.description: True if this call is a retry of a previous failed call.

retry_of_tool_call_id.description: If a retry, the tool_call_id of the original attempt.

next_action_kind.description: What the agent did immediately after this call.

preceding_tool_name.description: Tool name of the immediately preceding call (for pattern analysis).

following_tool_name.description: Tool name of the immediately following call.

is_delegation.description: True if this is a task() delegation call.

delegation_agent_profile.description: Agent profile used for the delegated task.

delegation_child_session_id.description: Session ID of the delegated child task.

is_human_interaction.description: True if this call represents a human interaction.

receipt_candidate.description: Whether this call generated a Merkle receipt.
